name: Dub
desc: Dub is the modern link attribution platform for creating, managing, and analysing short links, tracking conversions, and running affiliate programmes.

actions.name: create_link
actions.description: Create a new shortened link in your Dub workspace.

actions.name: get_link
actions.description: Retrieve details of a specific Dub link by its ID, external ID, or domain + key.

actions.name: list_links
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of links in your Dub workspace.

actions.name: update_link
actions.description: Update an existing Dub link. Only the fields you fill in will be updated.

actions.name: delete_link
actions.description: Permanently delete a Dub link. This action cannot be undone.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: link_clicked
triggers.description: Triggers in real time whenever one of your Dub short links is clicked.

triggers.name: link_created
triggers.description: Triggers in real time whenever a new short link is created in your Dub workspace.
